339425.title: Ternary Goldbach conjecture with primes in one progression modulo $3$
339425.literal_statement:
Let $p,q,r$ be primes. **The ternary progression Goldbach conjecture.** Every odd integer $n>5$ can be written as

$$
n=p+q+r,
$$

with

$$
p\equiv q\equiv2\pmod3.
$$

This is stated as a ternary analogue of one of the explicit mod-$4$ refinements. The paper notes that results for the binary case would also yield ternary consequences, but this particular progression statement remains unproved.

368163.literal_statement:

$$
scc(G)\leq \frac{7}{5}|E(G)|.
$$

This conjecture gives a sharp proposed upper bound for shortest cycle covers and is related in the paper to the parameter $T(G)$. It remains open.
